items.text: Connect makes cards for your Chinese library, with pinyin and the sentence's audio.
hato finds subtitles for a Chinese video that has none.
An audiobook with its own timed subtitle lines up its book at once.
Cards without audio can get an AI voice that runs on your PC (beta).
Ask Piyo how to do something in Surasura, or what's wrong.
A book card's sentence is the one that holds the word, within your Length.
順: your reorder finishes one that was cut off.
A subtitle that shifts part-way is re-timed by itself.
A line near a scene cut never makes a card.
Words split more truly (という, unknown names).
